statement: Every time-dependent node-liveness fact consumed by readiness or planning is decided by one NodeLivenessSemanticProjectionOwner from the readiness TimeSource, and its immutable per-node semantic projection plus earliest next-change deadline advances correctly from authoritative writes and passage of virtual time without writes. The cutover inventory classifies every current computation site by semantic fact, owner, threshold, duplicate, and disagreement; contradictory definitions of one fact are resolved while distinct facts retain distinct thresholds. The owner exposes immutable projectNodeLiveness(nodeId, nowMs) results and per-node semantic generations, coalesces all known future semantic transitions onto one shutdown-safe timer through the readiness setTimeoutFn/clearTimeoutFn seam, changes generation only when projected semantics change, and lazily reprojects overdue deadlines before consumer reads. No readiness or planning caller computes heartbeat freshness, lease validity, repair freshness, transport grace, or another time-derived node-liveness verdict locally; planning concerns and planning-generation invalidation remain outside this Quest.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
ReadinessPlanningSnapshotOwner may consume liveness projection identity but must not recreate node-liveness predicates or schedule their expiry timers.

Do not choose one global liveness timeout: derivation grace, cluster-member freshness, lease validity, repair freshness, and transport grace retain distinct semantics unless the inventory proves two definitions answer the same fact and resolves that authority conflict here.
Time-derived liveness decisions consume numeric nowMs from the readiness TimeSource; Date.now, ISO diagnostics, pass-start timestamps, and virtual time are not mixed as semantic currencies.
This Quest does not implement planning-generation granularity, STORAGE_RESERVATIONS planning currency, token-only planning inputs, cached-readiness planning feedback, or the GCP planning baseline.
